title: ReleaseAsset

name.description: The asset's file name on the release: agent-harness-linux-x64.tar.gz.

kind.description: What an asset is: environment, desktop, install-script, compose, host-updater, schema (environment being the environment's self-contained artefact for one platform); a kind the reader does not know is a later release's, and is passed over.

anyOf.description: A platform, <os>-<arch> as Node names them: linux-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64; a later release may add others.

platform.description: The platform it is built for; null for one any platform takes, such as a script.

anyOf.description: How an asset is packed: tar.gz or zip for the environment's artefacts, zip (a macOS bundle), nsis (a Windows setup) or pacman (an Arch package) for the desktop's, as its shell reports the format it installs.

format.description: How it is packed; null for a plain file.

size.description: Its size in bytes, checked with its SHA-256 before it is unpacked.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

environment.description: On a desktop build, where the environment it bundles is: an environment whose platform has no environment asset updates from it (#2196). Absent on every other asset.

payload.description: The archive inside the build the environment is in, where the build is an installer that stores one: app-64.7z, which the Windows setup stores uncompressed and the environment carves out of it by its 7z signature. Absent where the build is itself the archive (the macOS zip).

path.description: The environment's folder inside the build, or inside its payload, as a relative / separated path: under the app bundle's Contents/Resources in the macOS zip, under resources in the Windows setup's app-64.7z. Unpacked, it has the environment asset's top level (node/, packages/cli/, bin/).

description: One asset of a release: its name, kind, platform, format, size and SHA-256, and on a desktop build where the environment inside it is.
